differences.openwhisper: A source run keeps its data in the working directory or the checkout when that holds openwhisper_settings.json or .git, and .env falls back to <checkout>/.env.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: The data root is OPENWHISPER_CPP_DATA_DIR or the per-user folder however the program was started, and .env is only <data_root>/.env.
differences.reason: The checkout rule exists for `python main.py`; a compiled program has no checkout, and a working-directory rule would let a launch from another folder open different data.
differences.source: docs/port/ARCHITECTURE.md 3.1 'A source checkout never becomes the data root (... deliberate difference)'; docs/port/packages/M0.md Scope rows A01-01 and A01-03

differences.openwhisper: Only Linux enforces one UI per data folder (flock in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR plus an abstract socket, both named with the uid); Windows and macOS get a no-op primary and rely on the frozen build's mutex or the Dock.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: Every platform enforces it with a QLockFile in the temporary folder and a QLocalServer (a named pipe on Windows) keyed by the same data-folder hash; a second launch brings the first window forward. The lock and server names carry the account between the prefix and the key: the uid on POSIX, as OpenWhisper's Linux names do, and on Windows the first eight hex digits of the SHA-256 of the lower-case account name, so two accounts sharing one data folder do not collide.
differences.reason: The updater's application mutex does not bring the running window forward and does not separate data folders; one mechanism serves every platform. Windows has no uid, and its pipe names are one namespace for the whole machine.
differences.source: docs/port/packages/M0.md Scope row A01-31 ('M0.11 (all platforms, deliberate difference)') and the map's porting note for services/ui_instance.py; the shell sweep of 2026-11-19 (open item ui_shell/single_instance.cpp): src/ui_shell/posix/instance_user_posix.cpp, src/ui_shell/win/instance_user_win.cpp (not yet compiled on Windows), tests/ui_shell/test_sweep_instance_user.cpp ('the instance name carries the account between the prefix and the key', "another account's lock on the same data folder does not keep this one out")

differences.openwhisper: The diagnostics report's 'packaged' is sys.frozen: true for every frozen build, installed or unpacked by hand.
differences.openwhisper-cpp: 'packaged' is true only for a copy that runs from the folder its installer registration names; a copy unpacked by hand or run from a build tree reports false.
differences.reason: A native executable has no frozen flag, and OpenWhisper_CPP ships through its setup only, so the registration is what marks an installed copy.
